claims.label: Candace framed Kanye's then-forthcoming book "Break the Simulation" as a Blexit-aligned target on April 13, 2018
claims.claim: In the April 13, 2018 text exchange (A-1270.1), Candace tells Charlie that Kanye West was writing a philosophy book titled "Break the Simulation" and explicitly tags him "Blexit AF."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange (carrier records, device forensics).

claims.label: Charlie described Kanye as his "soul brother" and pledged to reach him in April 2018
claims.claim: Charlie's reply in the April 13, 2018 text exchange states he loves Kanye and "will find a way to him" with a promise to do so.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and any subsequent contact logs between Charlie and Kanye representatives.

claims.label: On the evening of April 20, 2018 Charlie framed the moment as "on the brink of something big"
claims.claim: The host says Charlie's April 20, 2018 evening message said he was on a run blasting Kanye West and that "we're on the brink of something big and like this is our time."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and corroborating device or carrier records.

claims.label: Charlie and Candace reacted with shock to Kanye's April 21, 2018 tweet
claims.claim: Per the April 21, 2018 morning text exchange the host shows, Candace wrote "Please pick up" (she says she was shaking) and Charlie wrote "I am freaking the f out."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the text exchange and timestamps.

claims.label: Mike Cernovich publicly discussed a cosmic "energy shift" in mid-April 2018
claims.claim: Per the Mike Cernovich tweets the host shows, which she says he posted around April 16, 2018 and has since deleted, Cernovich wrote that high-consciousness people were reporting a paradigm-level energy shift that began two-to-three weeks earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copies of Cernovich's tweet thread (Wayback Machine, third-party archives) to verify wording and dating.

claims.label: Candace concurs with Cernovich's "energy shift" framing
claims.claim: Host asserts that Cernovich's tweets confirmed her and Charlie's contemporaneous experience of the same shift.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and timestamp any other contemporaneous public statements or private messages corroborating the "energy shift" framing.

claims.label: Kanye West publicly praised Candace Owens on April 21, 2018
claims.claim: Kanye West posted "I love the way Candace Owens thinks" on April 21, 2018.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copy of original Kanye tweet from independent platform (e.g., Wayback Machine, X data export).

claims.label: Scott Adams characterized Kanye's tweet as reality-altering
claims.claim: Scott Adams, in commentary played on air, stated Kanye "ripped a hole in reality with seven words" and "freed a lot of people from a mental prison."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and timestamp original Scott Adams video; verify exact wording against played clip.

claims.label: Candace stated in the December 2018 UK Q&A that Hitler was not a nationalist
claims.claim: In audio played on air, Candace states Hitler "was a national socialist" but argues he was not a nationalist because "he wanted to globalize."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original full Q&A video, confirm context of the audience question and any prior question framing.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet states Charlie drilled an emergency-call protocol into Mikey McCoy
claims.claim: In TPUSA audio played on air, Andrew Kolvet states Charlie repeatedly instructed Mikey that "If anything ever happens to me, you call Erika," and that Mikey followed that protocol after the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether Mikey McCoy himself has publicly corroborated Kolvet's account, and obtain any contemporaneous record of the alleged instruction.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet states Mikey McCoy was capturing social video, not on the phone, at the moment of the shot
claims.claim: Kolvet states Mikey was taking social-video clips for the TPUSA group chat at the time of the shot, with the phone in his hand only as he covered his ears due to the loud blast.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full video clip from which Kolvet's narration derives, and time-stamp Mikey's actions frame-by-frame.

claims.label: Alex Marlow Compares Online Conspiracy Mindset to Addiction
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from the Charlie Kirk show, Breitbart News head Alex Marlow characterizes the suggestion that Mikey McCoy was part of a conspiracy to murder Charlie as "vile" and likens the mindset fueling such claims to social-media or pornography addiction, saying they get a high off it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify date and outlet of Marlo's full segment; obtain full unedited clip.

claims.label: Frank Turek defends Mikey McCoy and rebukes Candace for advancing unevidenced claims
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Frank Turek states there is a 'difference between a possibility and evidence for a possibility,' tells people who have no evidence to 'shut up,' and calls Mikey McCoy, who he says was 23 at the time, a hero that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify date and outlet of Turk's full segment; confirm Mikey McCoy's age at the time of the September 10 event.

claims.label: A UVU Hospital internal message restricted access to a Charlie Kirk trauma file to two named individuals
claims.claim: Host displays a hospital internal message (received per host at 20:08; she later says she meant Utah Valley Hospital, not UVU) stating that, due to a media event that led to a trauma patient, only "Deborah" and the sender, "Jacob Blank," are allowed in the chart.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of the message (forensic metadata, screenshots from multiple UVU staff); identify the two named individuals and their institutional roles.

claims.label: A Charlie Kirk medical file existed at Utah Valley Hospital on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: The host says she received tips that Charlie was at UVU and an email from someone on the UVU medical staff saying they were certain he was there, with his entry in the UVU system and an internal message restricting access to the file (A-1278.1), while saying there could be a logical explanation she has not found; she later corrects UVU to Utah Valley Hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification from UVU medical staff or institutional records; reconcile with the contemporaneous routing to Timpanogos Regional Hospital.

claims.label: Host Says Rob McCoy's Father Roy Edgar McCoy Was a Navy Psychological Warfare Officer
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, George Webb says Rob McCoy has a "strange military background" and was guiding Charlie toward a NAR-aligned apostolic movement; the host says Rob McCoy's father Roy Edgar McCoy was a naval captain and assistant chief of staff for psychological warfare in the Navy.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Roy Edgar McCoy's official Navy service record; confirm Webb's claim against public biographical sources.

claims.label: The McCoy orbit is tied to the NAR-aligned Ziklag donor network
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, George Webb says Rob McCoy is "kind of the NAR push for Charlie," that Charlie was meeting with NAR, and that NAR were the "$25 million and above" Christian-right donors, the organization being Ziklag.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent verification of Ziklag's donor list and any documented overlap with TPUSA personnel or events.

claims.label: Brigitte Macron is registered on French tax forms as "Jean-Michel" male
claims.claim: The host says Brigitte Macron is listed on French tax forms as Jean-Michel and as male, and cites a government official, Mr. Bromet, who recounted that she was stunned to learn her legal name had been changed when she logged into her personal tax account.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original French reporting, the Bromet statement, and any tax-form documentation referenced; verify the dating of the records.

claims.label: Candace rejects the official "hacker" explanation for the Macron tax-form discrepancy
claims.claim: Host rejects the public suggestion that the "Jean-Michel" entry was the product of a hacker, arguing the risk/reward of hacking a sitting president's records solely to change a name entry is implausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and obtain the original reporting cited by host; obtain French government statement (if any) addressing the discrepancy.
